3.message: 6 Personen in einem kleinen Hubschrauber ist einfach zu viel. Man sieht kaum etwas und kann keine guten Fotos machen. Die Hundeschlittenfahrt war sehr schön

4.message: Something I have always wanted to do. We were very late in the season so the snow was very wet, wish we had longer on the sled and more interaction with the dogs possibly learning how to harness them and attach to the sled. The glacier landing was good saw blue water river but didn’t get to go into any ice caves.
It was a nice trip with beautiful views from the helicopter. Dog sledding was a unique trip but very quick. For the money we spent it’s a one and done deal.
Emilia was an amazing guide. She interacted with us and was very informative.
It was a new type of experience for my family and I. Of course we enjoyed it but I’m not sure if it was worth all that money. I think adding a few professional photos would be an amazing idea.

5.message: Everything was just perfect!! Amazing!!!
Our mushing guide was full of interesting information but wasn't really a people person. He was helpful in taking pictures of us but was too slow so we didn't have much time with the puppies.

It was awesome! Although a little on the pricey side. The pilot and musher were brilliant. Not only got time with the dogs but the puppies also. The walking on the glacier was fab and Ben our pilot was very attentive and knowledgeable. Wonderful experience.
Wonderful! Ben was awesome and so was the tour. 100% recommended.

Everything is great. I wish the sledding part was longer and maybe the run would be parallel to other teams like a miniature race... But that's merely a a suggestion for improvement. Overall I'm 95% satisfied. The helicopter flight was awesome, we saw bears 🐻🐻🐻🐻🐻 on the mountains, a beautiful huge glacier we flew over, and the pilot's comments were spot on - not an excessive narration, but he pointed out the important stuff. And we got a chance to chat about personal life a little - it felt like a new friend took you on a flight in his helicopter - great experience. The puppies are a delight. I got a chance to work on conquering my fear of dogs because even all the adult dogs were super sweet. Thank you!
Genial 👍🏻
A little expensive for the time but very fun
Una magnífica experiencia!

While the price tag was definitely more than our typical budget, it was definitely worth it. Everything was well organized and it was clear safety was the number one priority for both humans as well as the dogs. The helicopter ride was amazing and my husband and I felt very secure and safe. It truly was a once in a lifetime opportunity. We are glad we spent the money and the time on this excursion.

Awesome! The helicopter rides de to the dogs was amazing! Them landed at camp husky even better! Alaskan Huskies all wanting to say hi! We got to pet all of them so friendly and kisses! If you are a dog lover, this is a must! When they pulled out the sleds to choose the dogs, all the dogs went crazy to be picked for the next run. It was amazing watching every single dog howling saying pick me pick me. Would definitely recommend the store to anybody one of the best stores we’ve ever had
It was an excellent experience! Must for anyone who is visiting Alaska!
Excelente experiencia!
Bucket list experience. Incredibly well organised.

We enjoyed everything about the tour, friendly staff and informative about safety. Pilot very friendly and enjoyable to ride with. The dog team handlers were amazing and friendly. The dogs were wonderful to watch and interact with. This tour was extremely fun
Loved the chance to “mush” a team. Our musher taught us a lot about the sport. Got to meet and pet the dogs. Flight over (and pilot) to the base was great.

Ticked off the bucket list, helicopter and glacier dogsled tour. What an experience and adventure. Money well spent. Thank you Sam for our helicopter ride, thank you Sully for a sledging ride and thank you Alaska for the memories @AlaskaHelicopterTours #alaska #dogsledding #helicopter #bucketlistmoment #adventure #glacier
Seeing the sled dogs in their element was amazing. Our pilot gave a great tour. 10/10
It was fun. I wish they would talk about the wishing stone heritage on every tour. Very interesting. Loved going on the ice

Beautiful drive to the facility. No transportation offered that day so we rented a car. Check-in and safety brief were easy. Helicopter pilot did a good job getting us there. My one and only negative was that he could have been personable or even spoke to us once. He didn’t talk at all regarding the area or where we were heading. Only time I’ve had a pilot who didn’t tell us anything about surrounding landscape/area on the way there or the way back. The crew on the glacier were phenomenal! Very informative and eager to share their extensive knowledge. Dog sledding on the glacier was amazing. Beautiful scenery and the dogs are awesome. Our guide up top races the Iditarod and shared a lot of fun and interesting facts about the race and life on the glacier. Amazing experience. Great time. Highly recommend.
Great experience amazing to be able to see the glacier up close and explore

Once in a lifetime experience with excellent and knowledgeable guidance. This tour is worth the money and I would definitely recommend this tour for everyone. The dogs were so friendly and just love to run. I can’t fault any part of this tour. I would do it again in a heartbeat

We booked the combined trip with Flight and dog mushing! It was an amazing adventure. A quick trip to the top of the glacier and then a lap around the circuit with the fabulous Iditarod dogs. Our helicopter pilot was amazing as were the staff working with the dogs. It was a great day
It was all fantastic

The helicopter flight was brilliant and glacier landing pity the clouds stopped us from experiencing the dog mushing, safety first for sure would of been fun but the glacier landing g was amazing Cody was an excellent pilot and guide Thanks to all the team for a great morning
War ein super Erlebnis……ein unvergessliches Erlebnis……absolut zu Empfehlen

The best thing we did in Alaska. This felt Like a once. in a lifetime experience…. Because it was! Many people never see the glaciers from this vantage point…and it’s worth it! We climbed over water filled crevices and even drank water from them and the water was the best we’d ever had Sledding with the dogs was also an amazing experience to get a taste of what these dog sled teams do to prepare for the Iditarod
I would like to have dogsled a little more time, and longer sledding.
Ein atemberaubendes Erlebnis!
Me and my family really like it the pilot was perfect and all of the stuff
Everything is perfect, kids love it
This was amazing, suggest planning it towards the end of your trip so it is a highlight. Dogs run in the Iditarod!
Tolle Flug + Pilot, Musher Ben ebenso. Ein einmaliges Erlebnis!!

El personal aviso de manera oportuna que la parte de paseo en trineo con perros no iba a ser posible realizar debido a mal tiempo y es excelente pensando en seguridad del cliente, sin embargo el paso en helicoptero y al glaciar si fue posible y la atencion y explicacion de seguridad y del piloto Shine fueron excelentes. La amabilidad del piloto fue muy agradable y su explicacion en el vuelo y en el glaciar fueron extraordinarias. Nos facilitaron dispositivo para el calzado especial para caminar sobre el glaciar. El recorrido en el glaciar fue excelente ¡ recomindo 100% este paseo ¡¡¡
Una experiencia maravillosa. excelente servicio. el piloto del helicoptero es cortés y profesional. Vistas únicas y el trineo de perros y sus cuidadores son excepcionales. 100% recomendado.
